items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bette Davis had told me that she never did a movie in her life in which there was anybody named Peter

ctx.x: Do you want to finish with Bernie?

Yeah. With Bernie, the question was, what kind of name can we get? Then I thought about the classic thing that everybody did in doing takeoffs on Bette Davis. They always had that line about, “Peter, Peter, come here. Peter,” and so forth.
